Name: VideoToArticleAI
Note: English-first video/audio/transcript to editable article SaaS. Source-grounded drafts, Writing Profile, relevant screenshots, Markdown/DOCX/TXT export. URL import is not available yet. Articles stay private until the owner publishes them.
Title: VideoToArticleAI — Turn Video into an Article in Your Style
Short description(20-30 words): Turn your own video into a source-grounded, editable article in your writing style, with relevant screenshots and Markdown, Word, or TXT export.
Short Discription(100-150 words): VideoToArticleAI turns a video or audio file you own into a source-grounded, editable article. Upload MP4, MOV, WebM, or M4V up to 100 MB, or MP3, WAV, or M4A up to 20 MB, with a 10-minute limit. The workspace transcribes with timestamps, drafts structured sections, suggests relevant video frames, and keeps the article private until you publish. Export the saved version as Markdown, DOCX, or TXT. A Writing Profile can guide tone without changing source facts. URL import is labeled coming soon and is not available.
Tags Keywords/Hashtags: video to article, video to text, transcription, AI writing, writing profile, screenshots, markdown export, content creation, #VideoToArticleAI #VideoToText #AIWriting
